items.translation: 考虑指定的类路径位置。

items.source: A location can either be a special "classpath:" pseudo location or a standard location, such as com/example/resources. An empty String represents the root of the classpath.
items.translation: 位置可以是特殊的 `"classpath:"` 伪位置，或者是标准位置，例如 `com/example/resources`。空字符串表示类路径的根目录。

items.source: Consider the specified file prefixes. Any file whose name starts with one of the specified prefixes is considered. A prefix cannot contain the * character.
items.translation: 考虑指定的文件前缀。任何名称以指定前缀之一开头的文件都会被考虑。前缀不能包含 `*` 字符。

items.source: Consider the specified file extensions. A file extension must start with a . character.
items.translation: 考虑指定的文件扩展名。文件扩展名必须以 . 字符开头。
用于 `FilePatternResourceHintsRegistrar` 的构建器。

items.source: Register resource hints for the current state of this builder. For each classpath location that resolves against the ClassLoader, files with the configured file prefixes and extensions are registered.
items.translation: 为当前构建器的状态注册资源提示。对于解析到 `<code>ClassLoader` 的每个类路径位置，会注册具有配置的扩展名和文件前缀的文件。
考虑指定的文件扩展名。

items.source: Stephane Nicoll, Sam Brannen, Juergen Hoeller
items.translation: Stephane Nicoll, Sam Brannen, Juergen Hoeller

items.source: Register resource hints for the current state of this builder.
items.translation: 为当前构建器状态注册资源提示。

items.source: classLoader - the ClassLoader to use, or null for the default
items.translation: classLoader - 要使用的类加载器，或为默认值使用 null。

items.source: hints - the hints contributed so far for the deployment unit
items.translation: hints - 迄今为止为该部署单元贡献的提示
